items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the poem 'I Cannot Remember My Mother', and answer.

"I do not remember my grandfather's face, / but when rain drums softly on the tin roof / I hear the old radio he loved, / and the house smells again of wet earth and his pipe."

items.markingKey: Rain drumming softly on the tin roof (and the old radio) (1–2 marks for a complete answer.)

items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the poem 'I Cannot Remember My Mother', and answer.

"I do not remember my grandfather's face, / but when rain drums softly on the tin roof / I hear the old radio he loved, / and the house smells again of wet earth and his pipe."

Answer the following:
(i) What does the speaker not remember?  (a) His house  (b) The rain  (c) His grandfather's face  (d) The radio
(ii) Which sound brings back the grandfather?
(iii) Find an image of smell.  (a) "his face"  (b) "smells again of wet earth and his pipe"  (c) "the old radio"  (d) "rain drums softly"
(iv) How is this poem similar to Tagore's "I Cannot Remember My Mother"?
items.answer: (i) (c) His grandfather's face (ii) Rain drumming softly on the tin roof (and the old radio) (iii) (b) "smells again of wet earth and his pipe" (iv) Both speakers cannot remember a loved one but feel their presence through the senses.
items.markingKey: (i) (c) His grandfather's face (ii) Rain drumming softly on the tin roof (and the old radio) (iii) (b) "smells again of wet earth and his pipe" (iv) Both speakers cannot remember a loved one but feel their presence through the senses. (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
